text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 12 vials of bleomycin sulfate (3.1 days of supply). Corvale General holds 67 vials (22.7 days) and can spare 25 vials while retaining two weeks of inventory. Corvale Lakeside holds 16 vials (18.5 days) and can spare 3 vials while retaining two weeks of inventory. All sites use product labeled by Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NDC 71288010610) manufactured at the MEITHEAL plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include bleomycin sulfate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal redistribution is the fastest way to protect supply at Corvale East. External purchases are available but not urgent because the drug is not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 25 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East. Requires pharmacy director transfer request.
2. Transfer 3 vials from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. Requires pharmacy director transfer request.
3. Evaluate purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC if internal transfers are insufficient. Requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. if internal transfers are insufficient. Requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Hospira, Inc. if internal transfers are insufficient. Requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No action at this time.
